taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: CircleCI context secrets and workflow approval/source binding
controls.source_trace: Determine whether a lower-trust config revision can execute a context-bearing job or change the artifact after an approval.
controls.implementation_branch: Inspect context restrictions, project identity and approval job placement against the exact workflow revision. An approval event is not sufficient if a later untrusted script substitution changes what runs with the context. Fork/branch settings and expression restrictions may deny context access before execution; retain that denial as a specific negative control.
controls.operational_method: Record which approving actor is permitted by a restricted context security group and which project/expression restrictions the context-bearing job must satisfy. Workflow approval and context access are distinct decisions. Compare an approved job whose actor/context eligibility fails with an eligible actor using the same source revision. Do not treat a green approval node as proof that secrets were injected or that the approver authorized a later substituted script.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated config/local execution fixture with synthetic context values and inert publication; compare authorized and untrusted source contexts.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A context name in config or an approval click is not proof the consumed revision was trusted.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind contexts and approval to actual trusted job inputs, retesting legitimate release and fork/branch separation.
